# Every file the quickstart's `--smoke` run writes, sorted, relative to
# reports/<run-id>/. Generated by tests/test_example.py and diffed against a
# real run on every test invocation, so it cannot go stale.
#
# docs/runner-contract.md SS6 lists the complete tree WITH its `# only when:`
# conditions; what this file adds is which of those conditions actually fired
# for THIS run. Read the two together:
#   * routing_results.jsonl / routing_report.json  -- present: cases are routing-scorable
#   * actual.json (4 of 6 cases)                   -- present: those cases carry expect.result
#   * repeats.jsonl / reliability.json             -- ABSENT: k is 1
#   * comparison.json                              -- ABSENT: no --baseline-verdicts
#   * trajectory.json / trace.json                 -- ABSENT: the app is trace-less
#   * reports/.gitignore                           -- ABSENT: data.may_contain_pii is false
#     (and it would sit beside this directory, not inside it)
